text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That's what happens when you indulge
in snacks
every night.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You deserve to pay a high price for your
vices.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... I figured my training would offset
how much
I've been snacking.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Look at that pudge. It's cute.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If I used your lap as a comfy pillow,
I bet
I'd have
the most pleasant dreams.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm in the mood for a nap right
now.
Come on, let's go back to our
room.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be surprised if you have a
nightmare and
wake up with a stiff neck,
eh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Use me as a pillow?! I'm gonna make my
muscles
rock solid, then we'll see who's
the pillow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa trains hard and
successfully gets
back in shape.
